scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: At [07:22], you asked the customer which router model he has in his hallway, even though he had already stated he had the S-Net Hub 4X at [01:46].

grader.scenario: Intermittent Wi-Fi drops on Hub 4X after 8 PM due to DFS channel hopping
grader.notes: Marcus efficiently identifies DFS channel radar interference as the root cause of evening Wi-Fi drops, applies a manual non-DFS channel lock to channel 36, and verifies stable speed test throughput. However, he drops Active Listening by re-asking the customer's router model minutes after Aaron explicitly provided it.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net customer support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in the final turn.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Managed holds were announced and thanked appropriately without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent verified postcode, first line of address, and 4-digit PIN at [00:36] within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer by his first name Aaron naturally throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Validated customer's frustration about losing connection during live lectures at [00:26] ('I can completely understand how frustrating it is to lose your connection during a live lecture, Aaron').

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Paraphrased the issue at [01:05]: 'So what I am hearing is that the Wi-Fi connection drops out intermittently every evening around eight o'clock, specifically on your wireless devices. Have I got that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Customer stated 'It's the S-Net Hub 4X in the main hallway' at turn 11 ([01:46]), but Agent re-asked 'which router model do you have in your hallway there?' at turn 40 ([07:22]).

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent took direct ownership of diagnosing and applying the channel lock without deflecting.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Probed into frequency bands, wired vs wireless behavior, and router light indicators.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Confirmed speed test at 262 Mbps download and verified Wi-Fi stability with customer.
